sections.label: Where it begins
sections.title: Where the conversation <t>usually begins.</t>
items: You want to bring Barry’s to your city, and need a partner who has opened one before.
A first Barry’s studio that works, and a second and third that need to work the same way.
Two operators of the brand in neighbouring countries, and the case for becoming one company.
A fitness or wellness concept looking for capital that understands the floor as well as the spreadsheet.
A board that wants someone at the table who has carried a P&L.
A federation or club that wants its elite game run with the discipline of a commercial brand.

sections.label: Three ways in
sections.title: Three ways <t>to work together.</t>
sections.lede: Each one a chapter of the career, still open.

cards.label: Bringing Barry’s to a new city · Local entrepreneurs & Barry’s partners
cards.title: Who opens Barry’s in your city?
cards.desc: The Zürich pattern, applied to a new market: a local founder with the ambition, a partner with the experience of ten studios, and a launch run to the brand’s standard, in a way its headquarters can trust.
items: Partner and structure for the new company
Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland so far

cards.label: Investing in the next concepts · Founders of health & fitness concepts
cards.title: Whose capital has run the floor?
cards.desc: Through Stockholm Leisure Partners, an investor focused on the health and fitness industry: capital with operating experience, from the first studio to the Nordic and European market.
items: Investments have included Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize

cards.label: Boards & sport · Boards, federations & clubs
cards.title: Who sits at the table?
cards.desc: Board roles in business and in sport: strategy, commercial development and organisation, with the view of someone who has carried a P&L.
items: Commercial development of the elite game

sections.label: Through Stockholm Leisure Partners
sections.sub: Founding partner of Stockholm Leisure Partners, an investor focused on the health and fitness industry since 2015. Investments have included Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize.

sections.label: In his words
sections.title: From his <t>LinkedIn.</t>

items.q: “So proud to share that Barry’s Helsinki is officially open 🇫🇮🔥 Huge thanks to everyone who made this happen — it’s been an incredible team effort! See you on the treadmill.”

items.t: Elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy.
items.q: “Jag är både stolt och ödmjuk över att i helgen ha blivit vald till ledamot i förbundsstyrelsen för Svensk Innebandy.”
items.s: LinkedIn, July 2026 · “Both proud and humble to have been elected to the board of Svensk Innebandy this weekend.”

items.t: A new board, a new season.
items.q: “Inspirerande start med nya förbundsstyrelsen och Sportkontoret! Ser fram emot att bidra till utvecklingen av svensk innebandy – och inte minst till att stärka elitinnebandyn sportsligt, kommersiellt och organisatoriskt. Let’s go!”
items.s: LinkedIn, September 2026 · “Looking forward to contributing to Swedish floorball, and not least to strengthening the elite game sportingly, commercially and organisationally.”

items.q: “Barry’s x Balenciaga 🙌” — sharing Daniel Rabinovich: “Luxury used to be defined entirely by what you wore to a fancy dinner. Today, it’s defined by where you sweat.”
